ramadanNote: Ramadan has its own page — this list is for voluntary fasting only
fastError: Couldn’t load the fasting days. Check your internet connection.
fastNone: No Sunnah fast in the coming days.
fastCalculatedNote: Dates calculated on this computer while offline: they may differ by a day.
fastRemindOff: No reminder for this fast: turn it on in “Remind me”.
fastRemindEvening: Reminder the evening before, after Isha.
fastRemindBoth: Reminders the evening before (after Isha) and {minutes} min before Fajr.
fastFridayNote: Fasting a Friday on its own is disliked: fast Thursday or Saturday with it.
fastMakeUpHint: Ramadan fasts to make up: {count}. Making them up first is the safer choice, and this day can be one.
fastRemindersHint: Reminders appear in the corner of the screen while Salaty Time is running, also from the tray.
fastMakeUpNote: Making them up first is the safer choice. A make-up fast can be on any of these days.
fastShawwalNote: Any six days of Shawwal from the 2nd; one after the other is best.
fastNotToFastEids: The two Eids: 1 Shawwal and 10 Dhul-Hijjah.
fastNotToFastTashreeq: The days of Tashreeq: 11, 12 and 13 Dhul-Hijjah.
fastWhyMonThu: Deeds are presented to Allah on Mondays and Thursdays.
fastWhyWhiteDays: Three days each month: the 13th, 14th and 15th.
fastWhyAshura: Ashura expiates the past year; Tasu'a, the 9th, is fasted with it.
fastWhyArafah: Expiates the past year and the coming one. Not for pilgrims.
fastWhyDhulHijjah: The Prophet (peace be upon him) fasted the first nine days of Dhul-Hijjah.
fastWhyShawwal6: Ramadan followed by six days of Shawwal is like fasting all year. Reminded once, for the 2nd.
